CRITICAL METHODOLOGY FIX applied after initial run: relation_f1 came back exactly 0.0 on all 4 sheets in the first pass - root-caused to PID2Graph having ZERO direct equipment-to-equipment edges anywhere (every real connection routes through connector/crossing nodes), while the agent's BundleRelations always connect two equipment entities directly - the original metric could not score above 0 by construction, regardless of model quality. Fixed via ground_truth.contract_to_equipment_edges (degree-4 heuristic: tunnel through connector always, tunnel through crossing unless node degree==4 i.e. a true non-connecting visual crossing; validated by comparing 3 variants' degree distributions against plausible P&ID connectivity - naive tunnel-everything gave mean degree ~11 (unrealistic), block-all-crossings gave mean degree 0.27 (most equipment isolated), degree-4-heuristic gave mean degree ~1.9-2.1, max degree 5 (plausible)). Re-scored for FREE from saved artifact stores, zero new API calls. Results (entity F1 pre-13->post-13, relation F1 pre-12->post-12): OPEN100/8: 0.414->0.310 (stage13 net NEGATIVE here, removed correct entities), relF1 0.0->0.0 (only 1 relation built, low entity recall ~0.3 makes this plausible not a bug). OPEN100/1: 0.274->0.323 (stage13 positive), relF1 0.0->0.0 (same low-entity-recall cascade). DatasetPID/246: 0.685->0.719 (stage13 positive), relF1 0.077->0.108 (stage12 positive, real signal). DatasetPID/443: 0.682->0.692 (stage13 positive), relF1 0.173->0.185 (stage12 positive, real signal). Takeaways: (1) entity F1 much higher on Dataset PID sheets (~0.7) than PID2Graph OPEN100 sheets (~0.3) - worth investigating why. (2) stage13 helped 3/4 sheets, hurt 1/4 (OPEN100/8) - not a uniform net positive. (3) stage12 relation validation improved relation F1 on both sheets where it had enough signal to work with. (4) relation-F1 heuristic is still not visually verified against original drawings - treat as best current evidence, flag if a sheet's number looks suspicious later.
